projects.name: AI Software Factory
projects.tagline: AI-native software development workflow that transforms business requirements into implementation-ready software changes.
projects.role: Product Strategy · AI Architecture · AI Engineering · Workflow Design
projects.problem: Software teams spend significant time translating requirements into specifications, architecture decisions, implementation tasks and engineering changes.
projects.opportunity: A structured AI-native workflow can turn that translation from a manual bottleneck into an automated, repeatable product development path.
projects.product: An orchestration layer connecting specifications, specialist AI agents, engineering workflows and Git/PR automation.
projects.architecture: A staged pipeline moves a requirement through specification, architecture, specialist agents and implementation — with review and pull request automation at the end.
projects.ai: Agents · SDD · Context Engineering · MCP · Code Generation
decisions: Structure requirements before generation to keep context coherent
Use specialist agents instead of one general-purpose assistant
Make review and PR creation part of the flow, not an afterthought
Keep workflow orchestration independent of any single model
impact: Traceable path from requirement to pull request

projects.name: MARK1
projects.tagline: AI agent designed to connect support tickets, technical documentation and legacy codebases to accelerate technical investigation.
projects.role: AI Architecture · AI Engineering · Product Design
projects.problem: Technical support requires searching across tickets, documentation and complex legacy source code.
projects.opportunity: A progressive investigation flow can reduce the manual effort of tracing a support issue across disconnected knowledge sources.
projects.product: An agentic workflow that progressively investigates documentation, the support ticket and the codebase to produce a grounded technical answer.
projects.architecture: A support request flows through an orchestrator that queries documentation, tickets and the codebase, retrieves relevant context and hands it to an agent that composes an answer.
projects.ai: LangGraph · RAG · Chroma · BM25 · Embeddings · Reranking · Code Analysis
decisions: Investigate progressively — documentation first, then ticket, then code
Combine BM25 and embeddings for hybrid retrieval
Add reranking to prioritize the most relevant context
Include dependency and code analysis for legacy codebases

projects.name: Luna
projects.category: Enterprise AI Knowledge Platform · B2B SaaS
projects.tagline: Multi-tenant AI knowledge platform that transforms organizational knowledge into governed, context-aware AI capabilities.
projects.role: Product Strategy · AI Solutions Architecture · AI Engineering
projects.problem: Business knowledge is distributed across documents, meetings, systems and technical information, making it difficult to retrieve and use consistently.
projects.opportunity: A governed knowledge layer can turn fragmented organizational knowledge into reliable, context-aware AI capabilities.
projects.product: A multi-tenant knowledge platform combining ingestion, retrieval, AI agents, governance and enterprise integrations.
projects.architecture: Organizational knowledge is ingested into a governed knowledge layer, then exposed through RAG and AI agents to business applications — with tenant isolation, privacy and observability.
projects.ai: LangChain · LangGraph · Qdrant · Docker · RAG · AI Agents
decisions: Tenant isolation as a first-class constraint
Privacy by design and LGPD compliance
Governance and observability built in from the start
Cost control as an explicit product principle

projects.name: MCP Platform
projects.category: AI Infrastructure · API Governance · Enterprise Architecture
projects.tagline: A governed MCP/API access layer that enables enterprise AI agents to interact with business systems through controlled, observable interfaces.
projects.problem: Enterprise AI agents need access to business systems, but direct API access creates security, governance and data-control challenges.
projects.opportunity: A governed access layer lets organizations expose capabilities to AI agents without losing control over security and data.
projects.product: A platform where organizations can expose controlled capabilities to AI agents while maintaining governance, security and observability.
projects.architecture: Enterprise capabilities are exposed through an MCP gateway with authentication, authorization, guardrails and observability — a controlled interface between business systems and AI agents.
projects.ai: MCP · API Proxy · Authentication · Authorization · Guardrails · Observability
decisions: Standardize agent access behind a single governed interface
Apply guardrails and policy controls at the gateway
Make multi-tenancy and observability core requirements
impact: Standardized agent access to business systems
